AI Application Developer with 3+ years of experience delivering AI applications, data pipelines, and machine learning solutions across enterprise and academic platforms. Proficient in Python, SQL, full-stack development, and DataOps tooling with hands-on experience building scalable analytics workflows, CI/CD-integrated pipelines, and MLOps-supported model validation. Proven ability to translate complex business needs into proofs of value and actionable, stakeholder-ready insights using Agile methodologies and version control best practices.

Skills
Programming & Data Analysis: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn), SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), R, Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, VBA), Statistical Analysis
Data Visualization & BI: Power BI (Data Modeling, DAX, KPI Reporting), Tableau (Dashboard Design, Visual Analytics), Leaflet.js, Interactive Dashboards, Geospatial Visualization, Self-Service BI
Analytics & Modeling: EDA, Data Cleaning and Wrangling, Feature Engineering, Time-Series Forecasting, Predictive Analytics, Model Validation (MAE, RMSE, MAPE), Statistical Modeling, Hypothesis Testing
Databases & Tools: PostgreSQL, MySQL, NoSQL, Git, GitHub, Docker, Azure, ETL Processes, Data Pipeline Architecture, Automated Reporting, Data Validation, Data Quality Assurance

Professional Experience

CTA Safety Analytics and Mapping System – Academic Research Project Chicago, IL
Data Analyst Apr 2025 – Present
– Reimagine a full-stack Geospatial Visualization and Interactive Dashboards safety analytics platform using Python and Leaflet.js, enabling drill-down spatial analysis from bus routes to assault context and cutting investigation time by approximately 70%.
– Design an ETL reporting pipeline following ETL Processes and Data Pipeline Architecture best practices with CI/CD basics using ReportLab and Matplotlib, including data validation checks transforming raw geospatial data into KPI-ready visual summaries and decreasing manual charting effort by 60%.
– Integrate a prototype AI applications layer combining rule-based logic with OpenAI-generated narratives, facilitating privacy-aware insight generation for cross-functional stakeholders and lowering manual explanation workload by 50%.
– Apply an analyst-focused approach to unify visualization, analytics, and narrative reporting workflows through dashboards, GitHub version control, and Docker-compatible tooling, accelerating stakeholder insight-to-decision cycles and doubling team speed in interpreting safety data.

Airobosoft – Financial Risk Case Study Analysis Remote
Financial Analyst Jul 2022 – Nov 2023
– Evaluated a banking-sector failure scenario using DataOps-informed financial analysis, identifying structural weaknesses in balance-sheet strategy, liquidity planning, and enterprise risk governance through comprehensive data pipeline review.
– Modeled interest-rate, liquidity, and deposit-concentration risk using machine learning, Feature Engineering, Time-Series Forecasting, and statistical modeling techniques, simulating 200–400 basis-point rate shocks on a 120B-dollar bond portfolio to assess exposure sensitivity.
– Quantified proofs of value showing 15–20% bond valuation declines representing approximately 15B dollars in unrealized losses alongside liquidity stress scenarios showing 25–30% rapid deposit withdrawal risk using predictive analytics.
– Demonstrated through MLOps-supported model validation and Data Modeling with Automated Reporting that improved hedging strategies and diversified funding structures could reduce interest-rate exposure by 40%, improve liquidity coverage by 30%, and lower bank-run probability.

Projects

Netflix Movie Data Analysis Apr 2025
– Analyzed over 5,880 Netflix titles using Python, Pandas, and NumPy alongside NoSQL data structures to perform exploratory data analysis on genre trends, release patterns, and viewing distributions for content acquisition decisions.
– Implemented Data Cleaning and Wrangling via data quality assurance processes using Git for version control to structure raw CSV datasets, resolving missing release dates and consolidating twelve genre categories into standardized analytical groupings.
– Delivered six EDA visualizations using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Power BI with Dashboard Design, Visual Analytics, and Self-Service BI principles to facilitate data storytelling and communicate insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
– Identified consumption patterns through statistical analysis showing Drama, Comedy, and Action comprising 63% of viewed content, informing acquisition prioritization and contributing to a 15% improvement in viewer engagement.

Walmart Sales Insights and SQL Reporting Apr 2025
– Assessed 7,425 transaction records across three retail branches using SQL, Python, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query) to evaluate daily performance trends, peak sales hours, and product-level demand patterns for inventory decisions.
– Developed and optimized ten SQL queries leveraging time-series data analysis including joins, aggregations, and subqueries for KPI reporting, identifying Fridays as having 22% higher transaction volume than the weekly average.
– Visualized operational metrics using Tableau and Python dashboards hosted on Azure, enabling business teams to reduce overstocking by 12% through improved demand visibility, real-time monitoring, and predictive restocking alerts.
– Applied Agile iterative methods to highlight top-selling product lines and preferred payment methods through cross-tabulation analysis, improving branch-level revenue tracking accuracy by 15% for stakeholder reporting.
